evals.prompt: I built this site: https://www.lucide.zone/ — give me a full design-jury style review of it. How would it score on awwwards, and what exactly should I improve? I want an HTML scorecard I can work from.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML scorecard with all nine jurors (Art Director, UX Lead, Creative Director, Content Strategist, Creative Developer, Software Architect, Accessibility Specialist, Performance Engineer, Product Strategist), official awwwards weighting (Design 40 / Usability 30 / Creativity 20 / Content 10), a developer-jury section with the six official categories, an extended advisory panel, evidence-based criticisms each paired with a concrete fix, a prioritized fix list, correct weighted arithmetic, and unobservable criteria marked Not assessed rather than invented.
assertions: An HTML scorecard file is saved to the outputs directory

All nine jury roles are present in the scorecard (Art Director, UX Lead, Creative Director, Content Strategist, Creative Developer, Software Architect, Accessibility Specialist, Performance Engineer, Product Strategist)
The official awwwards weights (Design 40%, Usability 30%, Creativity 20%, Content 10%) are used and shown
The weighted overall score is arithmetically consistent with the per-criterion scores (within 0.1)
A developer-jury section evaluates the six official categories (WPO, RWD/Mobile, Semantics/SEO, Markup/Metadata, Animations, Accessibility)
Every criticism is paired with a concrete, actionable fix
A priority fix list with at least 8 items is present
Criteria that could not be observed are marked Not assessed rather than given invented scores
